name: Osborn (The Osborn)
headline: Tri-County Housing, Inc. (Total Concept) won $930,000 a year in 2022 federal 9% credits for The Osborn, a 30-unit permanent supportive housing building replacing a motel it owns at 515 Elm Ave. in Rocky Ford, the first such project in southeast Colorado, with Division of Housing vouchers on all 30 units.
why_it_matters: It is a test of rural PSH on the Eastern Plains: no permanent loan, all-unit project-based vouchers and DOH gap money, and four years after award no public record confirms construction, so it is a deal to check before counting its 30 units.

status.label: Credits awarded 2022; construction start and completion not confirmed
status.detail: No dated public record of a financing closing, building permit, demolition, groundbreaking or opening was found. The architect's project page lists 'Date complete: 2026' without supporting detail. The deal does not reappear in CHFA's 2023-2024 award reports or the 4% award report.

next_step: Check City of Rocky Ford building permit and demolition records for 515 Elm Ave., Otero County recorder for a CHFA land use restriction agreement, and DOLA State Housing Board award records for the Division of Housing grant.

key_numbers.meaning: 9 at 30% AMI and 21 at 60% AMI, all for households leaving homelessness, all with Division of Housing project-based vouchers.
About $9.3M over 10 years (inferred); the request was cut by about $45,000 a year from the letter-of-interest estimate.

key_numbers.value: $75,000 per unit of DOH gap funding (planned)
key_numbers.meaning: About $2.25M for 30 units (inferred), which lets the deal carry no permanent mortgage.

background.text: Prior use: an existing motel owned by Total Concept with ten occupied units; the budget carried $250,000 for permanent relocation under a Uniform Relocation Act plan and $114,869 for demolition.
Origin: Total Concept began planning regional PSH in 2019 with an Enterprise Community Partners capacity grant and assessed Eastern Plains sites in 2020 before choosing its Rocky Ford motel.
Environmental: a nearby gas station leak led to a Phase II assessment (2022-01-20) that found no exceedances.

Sponsor's portfolio: Total Concept, based in Fowler, owns and manages small rural properties including a 25-unit tax credit property in Las Animas and 24-unit and 20-unit complexes in La Junta; the narrative calls The Osborn the first tax-credit-funded PSH project in the region and for Total Concept.
